name: FUSE4CCAM UC3: microscopic traffic management
description: Use case 3 of FUSE4CCAM: federated real-time traffic data from the Helmond and Hamburg pilot sites, feeding digital twins and traffic management. Only the participants and their link to UC3 come from the proposal: task T7.4 (DLR, AKKODIS, Monotch, TNO, Yunex), the pilot sites Helmond and Hamburg, and NDW as partner in the Helmond DITM data space. Everything else is made up for this simulation, including which datasets each party publishes, locations, formats, sizes and access terms; WP7 has not started. Entries are described in mobilityDCAT-AP 3.0.0 (draft), and each distribution points at its data standard in the Vocabulary Hub.

catalogProfiles.title: mobilityDCAT-AP 3.0.0 (draft)
catalogProfiles.description: The stable draft of mobilityDCAT-AP 3.0.0, extending DCAT-AP 3.0.1, whose shapes it imports and which are included here. Its release as a NAPCORE Recommendation is being voted on.

assets.name: Signal phase and timing with intersection maps, Helmond
assets.description: Live signal states (SPaT) and intersection topology (MAP) of the connected traffic lights in Helmond, streamed through TLEX.

assets.name: Signal priority requests and responses, Helmond
assets.description: Priority requests from emergency vehicles and public transport to the Helmond traffic lights (SREM), with the controllers' answers (SSEM). Shows when priority was granted, rejected or overruled.

assets.name: Cooperative awareness probe data, Helmond corridor
assets.description: Position, speed and heading broadcast by connected vehicles on the Helmond corridor (CAM), as input for microscopic traffic analysis and digital twins.

assets.name: Road hazard and event warnings, Netherlands
assets.description: Event warnings exchanged over C-ITS in the Netherlands (DENM), such as road works, stationary vehicles and an approaching emergency vehicle.

assets.name: Intersection detector counts, Helmond
assets.description: Vehicle counts and occupancy from the induction loops at the signalised intersections in Helmond, aggregated per minute.

assets.name: Traffic speed and flow, national road network
assets.description: Speed and flow per measurement site on the Dutch main and regional roads, from the national access point.

assets.name: Safety-related traffic information, Netherlands
assets.description: Safety-related traffic events on Dutch roads (SRTI), such as wrong-way drivers, obstacles and unprotected accident areas, from the national access point.

assets.name: Traffic light state forecasts, Hamburg
assets.description: Current and forecast signal states of Hamburg's traffic lights, published on the Urban Data Platform as OGC SensorThings observations.

assets.name: Traffic counts, Hamburg
assets.description: Vehicle and cyclist counts from detectors across Hamburg, published on the Urban Data Platform as OGC SensorThings observations.

assets.name: Signal programmes and controller events, Hamburg
assets.description: Signal programmes, detector events and controller status from traffic controllers in Hamburg, exchanged with the central traffic computer over OCIT.

assets.name: Road user trajectories from roadside perception, Hamburg
assets.description: Trajectories of vehicles, cyclists and pedestrians at an instrumented Hamburg intersection, detected by roadside cameras and radar and shared as collective perception messages (CPM).

assets.name: Microscopic traffic simulation model, Helmond corridor
assets.description: Calibrated microscopic simulation of the Helmond corridor: road network, signal control and demand, used as the digital twin in which traffic management strategies for mixed CCAM traffic are tested.
